description: This file implements a command for the Git version control system, specifically handling remote extension commands through an interface that processes command strings, manages environment variables, and communicates with subprocesses for executing remote commands.

methods.name: char * strip_escapes(const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
methods.description: Processes escape sequences in the input string to generate command arguments for remote execution, with special handling of placeholders like %G and %V, and sets global variables based on placeholders encountered.

methods.name: void parse_argv(struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Splits a command line argument string into a vector of arguments, expanding escape sequences.

methods.name: void send_git_request(int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a Git request packet over a file descriptor, including optional virtual host information.

methods.name: int run_child(const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Starts a subprocess to run a specified command, possibly sends a Git request, and manages bidirectional data transfer.

methods.name: int command_loop(const char * child)
methods.description: Main loop reading commands from standard input and dispatching to appropriate handlers, including starting child processes for remote commands.

methods.name: int cmd_remote_ext(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Entry point for the 'git remote-ext' command, validating arguments and invoking the command loop.

ctags.name: cmd_remote_ext
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: parse_argv
ctags.pattern: /^static void parse_argv(struct strvec *out, const char *arg, const char *service)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)

ctags.pattern: /^static void send_git_request(int stdin_fd, const char *serv, const char *repo,$/
ctags.signature: (int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)

ctags.signature: (const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
